Name: (AT) DigiRugs
Author: Doragoun
Description:
One day I woke up and thought to myself "hey, wouldn't Digimon's crests look great on rugs?" That's how this mod was born...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCrfQoK.png[/img]
Right now, it adds a total of 24 new textures for rugs that you can access with the  paint bucket tool added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. For more information on how that works, I'd recommend reading AT's own mod description or its wiki [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url].

Once you have the appropriate tool, you can use it to apply the new textures to all 3x2 rugs in the game, namely the...
[list]
[*]Nautical Rug
[*]Dark Rug
[*]Red Rug
[*]Light Green Rug
[*]Green Cottage Rug
[*]Red Cottage Rug
[*]Mystic Rug
[*]Bone Rug
[*]Snowy Rug
[*]Pirate Rug
[*]Patchwork Rug
[*]Fruit Salad Rug
[*]Oceanic Rug
[/list]If there's one I missed, please let me know!

All in all, as I already said, there are 24 rugs: Each design's based on one crest and each crest has at least two color variations. The exception to this rule are the crests of light (pink flower/star), reliability (grey cross with triangles), sincerity (green tear drop) and hope (yellow sun).The first one simply has multiple color variations because I couldn't decide which one looked best, the other three have versions with slightly larger icons on them that fit vertical positions better.

If you've got questions or feedback, just leave a comment and I'll reply as soon as possible. If you like this mod, please consider endorsing it – that both improves visibility and makes me very happy. Also, if you ever use these rugs for designing your home (or the town... or the forest. Anything, really) please don't hesitate to leave a screenshot! I'd love to see what you do with them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sgtIh0y.png[/img]﻿
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you've already downloaded Alternative Textures.
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Extract it into your mods folder.
[*]Grab your paint bucket and go wild digifying your rugs.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fCufpbD.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url]﻿

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]UI Info Suite[/url]﻿

As usual, huge thanks to my friends from the SDV server. You're all great and your feedback and encouragement has helped tremendously! Special mention to Airyn for coming up with an idea how to shade these things.
